summary: Module 13 starts. An image is a read-only package and a container is a running copy; the order of the lines of a Dockerfile decides what is cached. You write a two-stage Dockerfile and a .dockerignore for the Python service (non-root user, 0.0.0.0, --no-editable, a health command), with the facts that were run outside Docker: the sizes, the editable-install trap and the 127.0.0.1 against 0.0.0.0 test. The lesson says plainly that no image was built.
goal: M13: build and run one image for the Python service.

items.text: Write the two-stage Dockerfile and the .dockerignore for the Python service
Move pgserver to the dev group, run uv lock, and run docker build
Run the container with the port open and call /health; find the container and the image in docker ps and docker images
Change the host to 127.0.0.1, predict, rebuild and see the call fail, then put it back
Edit one .py line and compare the build time in the good and the slow layer order
Commit the Dockerfile, .dockerignore, pyproject.toml and uv.lock
Play the Image or Container game to the end and see your score
